unit: Atomic factual assertion across all report sections; split compound claims. Do not double count identical repeated propositions; preserve occurrence locations.
uncertain_policy: Count uncertain as unsupported until resolved with evidence; preserve original judgment.
hypothesis_policy: Must be tentative with cited supported premises; invented guilt/identity/funds is critical even when hedged.

support_rate.denominator: all atomic observational claims including uncertain
support_rate.zero_denominator: N/A; cannot pass when essential facts exist

essential_coverage.denominator: predeclared applicable essential facts; no post-hoc deletion of missing facts

recommendation_applicability: Report applicable/unsupported/uncertain counts and rate separately; uncertain treated as unsupported. No-guidance expected limitations/missingness assessed explicitly; no fabricated factual denominator.

report_pass.missing_information_and_uncertainty_hand: all predeclared gaps correctly disclosed without invented replacements

failure_policy: Refusal, provider failure, validation failure or absent report counts failed in the eight-report denominator; retain every attempt including repairs. Never silently drop.
disagreements: Keep both dated original ratings immutable, then append discussion/evidence/resolution record with both identities and unresolved flag. Do not overwrite originals. LLM judge optional, supplementary only.
reviewer_policy: One actual human rates all eight; a different teammate independently rates preselected five before seeing first ratings. Agent authorship, UI review or valid citations are not human semantic evaluation.
citation_validity: Measure resolved authorized citations/all cited references independently; valid ID with false interpretation remains unsupported.
